title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 6. Strongly believes that the continued authorisation of hazardous pesticides must end immediately; stresses that the Commission should improve the rules on the substitution of hazardous substances in pesticides in order to favour effective, safe non-chemical alternatives; urges the Commission to refrain from approving or renewing pesticide active substances where safe use cannot be demonstrated or where essential data for a robust risk assessment are missing; calls on the Commission to ensure that the approval process is fully transparent and follows strict safeguards against conflicts of interest, duly taking into account the Ombudsman’s suggestions for improvement and to commit to putting an end to the use of all synthetic pesticides by 2035 at the latest;
